tools.name: set_delivery_endpoint
tools.description: Register and verify your BROKER delivery endpoint. Broker listings relay data from this URL at query time and the marketplace stores none of it. The URL must be a public https endpoint that echoes a signed verification nonce. Requires a seller API key.

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Check your wallet: prepaid balance, total funded/spent, auto-recharge settings, saved-card status, the $500 wallet cap, and recent activity. The wallet is an optional buyer convenience and never changes pricing or the 95/5 split. Requires your vm_live_ API key.

tools.name: fund_wallet
tools.description: Add prepaid credits to your wallet via a Stripe Checkout link ($10–$500 per top-up; balance capped at $500). Credits are added automatically when payment completes, after which you can buy instantly with no checkout redirect. Returns a checkoutUrl.

tools.name: setup_payment_method
tools.description: Save a card for instant off-session purchases and auto-recharge. Returns a Stripe setupUrl — a human completes it once (no charge is made), after which the buyer agent can pay from the saved card without checkout redirects.

tools.name: configure_auto_recharge
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic wallet top-ups. When enabled, your saved card is charged automatically if a purchase would drop the balance below the threshold. Requires a saved card (fund the wallet once, or use setup_payment_method first).

tools.name: bulk_purchase
tools.description: Buy multiple standard listings (up to 100) in a single charge, paid from your wallet or a saved card. The combined price must not exceed $500. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seller_dashboard · Private data: about_marketplace, register_agent, submit_idea, contact_marketplace, become_seller, sell_data, listing_history, list_health_data, search_health_data, set_delivery_endpoint, get_wallet_balance, fund_wallet, configure_auto_recharge, bulk_purchase, wallet_transactions · Public sink: submit_idea, contact_marketplace, sell_data · Destructive: update_listing, configure_auto_recharge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seller_dashboard · Private data: about_marketplace, register_agent, submit_idea, contact_marketplace, become_seller, sell_data, listing_history, list_health_data, search_health_data, set_delivery_endpoint, get_wallet_balance, fund_wallet, configure_auto_recharge, bulk_purchase, wallet_transactions · Public sink: submit_idea, contact_marketplace, sell_data · Destructive: update_listing, configure_auto_recharge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
